text:
Senator Bill Cassidy urges congressional action as Social Security insolvency nears
U.S. Senator Bill Cassidy, M.D., has used his social media platform to highlight concerns about the future of Social Security and criticize congressional inaction on reform efforts.
On August 3, 2026, Cassidy posted: . The following day, he announced his intention to address Congress directly: .
Later that same day, Cassidy criticized lawmakers for failing to take action: "Congress won’t even set up a process to address Social Security’s looming insolvency. That’s not leadership. That’s kicking the can down the road. We owe the American people more than that. https://t.co/rmckNDLlyM".
Senator Cassidy serves on several Senate committees, including Finance; Energy and Natural Resources; and Veterans Affairs, according to his official website. He is known for initiatives aimed at reducing health care costs and supporting coastal restoration and mental health reforms. Cassidy also co-founded the Greater Baton Rouge Community Clinic to provide free health and dental care for uninsured individuals in his community.
Cassidy's background includes undergraduate and medical degrees from Louisiana State University. He and his wife have raised three children together.
